analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 하락세 지속, RSI 과매도 구간 진입 확인. ADX 23.2로 추세 형성 초기 단계로 방향성 확정은 아직 이르다. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 2.36으로 급증했으나, 하락 추세 속에서의 급증은 매도세 강화 신호로 해석될 수 있다. 따라서 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: The downtrend persists for 3 consecutive sessions, with RSI entering oversold territory confirmed. ADX is at 23.2, indicating an early stage of trend formation, making directional confirmation premature. The volume ratio of 2.36, while a surge, can be interpreted as strengthening selling pressure within a downtrend. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (1,132,000) vs SMA5/20/50 (1,332,400/1,350,200/1,590,998): below short/mid-term trends, indicating weakness.
· Position vs SMA100/200 (1,796,062/1,507,125): below long-term trends, deepening weakness.
· 52-week position (25.4%) + current price near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.5→32.9): entered oversold, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (20092.6817→-3201.4245): worsening, signaling continued weakness.
· Bollinger Bands current price position (lower band 1,116,699): approaching lower band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (808,000): support expected at Pivot S1 (929,667).
· Swing resistance (1,587,000): potential for trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High): confirms continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.36x): surge in volume during decline, signaling increased selling pressure.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): conditions for observation met.
